title: Balanced Brackets
statement: A config file checker reads a string `text` made only of the brackets `(`, `)`, `[`, `]`, `{`, and `}`. The text is balanced when every opening bracket is closed by the same kind of bracket, and inner pairs close before outer ones. Return true if `text` is balanced.
constraints: text has only the six bracket characters

answerKey.pattern: Stack of open brackets; each closing bracket must match the top
keyPoints: For a closing bracket, the stack must not be empty and its top must be the matching opening bracket; pop it
At the end, the stack must be empty
edgeCases: Opening brackets left at the end
Right kinds in the wrong order: ([)]
acceptableSlowerApproaches: Repeatedly remove '()', '[]', '{}' pairs until nothing changes: O(n^2)

hints: When a closing bracket arrives, which opening bracket must it match?
The most recent unmatched opening bracket is the one to check: keep them on a stack.
Fail if a closing bracket finds an empty stack or the wrong kind on top; at the end, the stack must be empty.
